prompt:
Build a modern dark-themed crypto trading dashboard (web app). TECH: - HTML - TailwindCSS - JavaScript (no framework) - Simple PHP backend (optional) FEATURES: 1. LOGIN SYSTEM - Simple login form (username + password) - No need complex security 2. DASHBOARD (SINGLE PAGE STYLE) - Sidebar menu: - Dashboard - Trade - Deposit - Withdraw - Transactions - Settings - Clicking menu should NOT reload page - Use JavaScript to switch content dynamically 3. UI DESIGN - Dark gradient background (blue/purple) - Glass effect cards - Rounded UI - Clean and modern like trading apps 4. MAIN LAYOUT - Top bar with: - Logo (left) - Username (right) - Left sidebar - Center content area - Right panel (trade box) 5. TRADING SECTION - Fake trading (no real backend) - Input amount - BUY and SELL buttons - Show alert: WIN or LOSS randomly 6. CHART - Add TradingView chart - Default BTC/USDT 7. LIVE MARKET - Show: - BTC - ETH - BNB - XRP - Show price + % change - Use free API (CoinGecko) - Update every few seconds 8. BALANCE - Show balance text - Update visually when trade happens 9. PAGES CONTENT (dynamic) - Dashboard: show balance - Trade: buy/sell - Deposit: simple form - Withdraw: simple form - Transactions: placeholder - Settings: change password (UI only) GOAL: Create a clean, modern, interactive trading dashboard UI that feels like a real platform but works as a frontend real

.
